item.description:
Two problems that only showed up once Cursor's own app — rather than just the `cursor-agent` command line — was actually being used.
### Fixed - **A phantom "unknown" Cursor session.** Cursor's app sends Perch a signal for an empty, unsent chat box, and Perch was turning that into a session row labelled "unknown" that sat there idle forever. It's not a session you started and there was no way to get rid of it. Perch now ignores those, and any one already sitting in your list disappears. - **Closing Cursor left its sessions on screen.** A session running inside the Cursor app kept showing as busy — "Thinking…", spinner and all — for fifteen minutes after you closed the app, and then lingered as idle indefinitely. Those now end as soon as Cursor quits. Sessions you started with `cursor-agent` in a terminal are untouched: those quite legitimately outlive the app.
